name: Zetwerk
summary: Tech-led manufacturing platform (energy, precision, capital goods) with 26 own plants and ~7,000 suppliers; ₹5,012 Cr issue.
financials: FY26 revenue ₹15,913 Cr (+40%), adj. EBITDA 2.7%, net loss ₹1,606 Cr
positives: Revenue +40% in FY26; ₹13,062 Cr manufacturing order book
₹2,160 Cr of fresh issue repays debt
red_flags: Loss-making every year; ₹1,606 Cr loss FY26 incl. discontinued ops
No listed peer; ~60x adj. EBITDA, thin 2.7% margin
Half the issue is OFS by VC funds; only 10% retail quota
anchor: Anchor bidding 14 Oct; allocation not public yet
